description: This file defines a Java class 'UpdateSavingsOfficerCommandHandler', which handles commands related to updating the officer assigned to a savings account within the Fineract system. It uses Spring annotations for service declaration and transaction management, and implements a command handler interface to process such updates.

classes.name: UpdateSavingsOfficerCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles commands to update the officer assigned to a savings account. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and uses the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService to perform the update within a transactional context.

methods.name: UpdateSavingsOfficerCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to assign a field officer to a savings account by delegating to the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService.
